title: Fix the 2026-09-09 full-repository review: 3 blockers and the major findings

AC1.note: test/log/write-contract.test.ts: 7 cases, incl. the property 'whatever the writer accepts, the reader loads'. CLI reproduction re-run: --kind bogus-kind, --in-reply-to 0 and 1.5 all exit 1 with the legal values named, log keeps only its header, a legal append reads back.

AC2.note: test/client/renderable-lifetime.test.ts: 100 identical setRoster calls add 0 entries to Renderable.renderablesByNumber (was +5 per call). Barrier verified: restoring the leak turns 2 of 3 red.

AC3.note: test/client/tool-error.test.ts against a real serve with a poisoned log: client stays connected, keeps polling, and the server's text ('line 2') reaches the caller. A real transport loss still reads as a disconnect. Barrier verified: restoring the defect turns 2 of 3 red.

AC4.note: test/server/shutdown.test.ts: close() resolves with a client attached, and SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP each exit the process and leave an empty registry. Barrier verified: old ordering turns all 4 red. Test uses a bare Client, chosen by measuring both client shapes.

AC5.note: test/log/write-contract.test.ts 'concurrent appends': 5 writers racing one instant get 5 distinct seq values, and 5 distinct on disk. Barrier verified: removing the lock turns it red.

AC6.note: test/client/export-name.test.ts: 9 cases over hostile ids incl. ../../../../../tmp/pwned; the base name is sanitised and the resolved path is asserted inside cwd. Barrier verified: removing the sanitising turns 3 red.

AC7.note: test/mcp-management/server.test.ts: a call with target and yes:true reports wouldWrite true, written false, and existsSync(target) is false. yes and dryRun are off the tool's input schema entirely.

AC8.note: test/client/help-overlay.test.ts: every height 10..40 asserts the bottom border matches /^[border]+$/ and 'Esc closes' is on screen; helpBody never returns more lines than it is given. Barrier verified: restoring the overflow turns 2 red.

AC9.note: test/client/roster-overflow.test.ts: every name length 1..40 renders a non-blank row; a name that does not fit carries a cut marker; a full-width name leaves a separating column. Barrier verified: restoring the wrap turns 3 red.

AC10.note: Recorded mutation runs. Remove horizontalScrollbarOptions -> first-message.test.ts 3 fail (boundary heights 2/6, 3/9, 4/12, found by sweeping). Invert shutdown order -> shutdown-order.test.ts 1 fail. Drop the re-entry guard -> 1 fail. The stopped guards are the exception and it is recorded: four redundant guards, no single removal is caught, removing all four is.

AC11.note: test/installer/registry.test.ts 'liveness is about this room, not about that port': two entries on one live port, one with a pid that cannot exist; only the live one is returned.

AC12.note: bun run check: eslint clean, tsc clean, 255 tests pass. Removed: the duplicate ManagementServeOptions, jumpTo's direction, commandHelp's name, RoomClient.getAgentDetail and getLastSeenSeq, Footer.setWidth. The 0/N counter now reports 'N matches' before a position is known.
